name: pro.telehealthnearme/telehealth-compare
title: Telehealth near me
description: Compare U.S. telehealth programs (GLP-1, TRT, longevity): prices, labs, LegitScript, sources.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists the U.S. telehealth specialties this server covers, with each specialty’s slug, the treatment keys it accepts (for example semaglutide, tirzepatide, trt, sermorelin, nad) and how many programs it has. Use it when you need the exact category slug or treatment key before calling find_programs, or when the user asks what this source covers. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: find_programs
tools.description: Finds online telehealth programs in one U.S. specialty and sorts them by lowest advertised monthly price. Use it when the user asks which online program is cheapest, which programs offer a treatment (e.g. compounded tirzepatide, TRT, sermorelin), which are LegitScript-certified, or which fit a budget or state. Example arguments: {"category":"glp-1-weight-loss","treatment":"tirzepatide","state":"TX","maxMonthlyPrice":200}. Each result has monthly prices (membership included when billed separately), membership fee, approval type, blood-work requirement, LegitScript status, data status, check date, sources, a profile page URL and a `link`/`nextStep` to start; null means not published. Offer each result’s `link` as the user’s next step (it is state-aware when you pass `state`) and cite `profile` when you quote a price. affiliate=true marks referral links, which should be disclosed.

category.description: Required. Specialty slug (format: one of the enum values, as returned by list_categories). Map the user’s words: weight loss / Ozempic-type drugs -> glp-1-weight-loss; testosterone, ED, men’s hair loss -> mens-health-hormones; sermorelin, NAD+, glutathione, peptides, anti-aging -> longevity-peptides; menopause, HRT, women’s hair loss -> womens-health.

treatment.description: Optional. Treatment key for that specialty (format: lowercase key from list_categories). Keys: glp-1-weight-loss -> semaglutide, tirzepatide; mens-health-hormones -> trt, ed, hairLoss; longevity-peptides -> sermorelin, nad, glutathione, biomarkers; womens-health -> menopause, hairLoss, sleep. When set, only programs offering it are returned, sorted by its price.

state.description: Optional. The user’s U.S. state as a two-letter postal code (format: 2 letters, e.g. "TX"). Programs known to exclude this state are automatically filtered out of find_programs/search (and flagged in get_program/calculate_true_cost). Also added to outbound links; when a program does not publish state exclusions (`stateAvailability: "unconfirmed"`), remind the user to confirm at intake.

maxMonthlyPrice.description: Optional. Budget ceiling in U.S. dollars per month (format: number, e.g. 200). Compared with the lowest advertised monthly price, membership included when billed separately; programs without a published price are excluded.

partnersOnly.description: Optional, default false. true = only programs with an active affiliate partnership (they appear with affiliate=true).

legitScriptOnly.description: Optional, default false. true = only programs confirmed LegitScript-certified (directory confirmation, active seal, or verified certification status). Use it when the user asks for certified or legitimate providers.

tools.name: get_program
tools.description: Returns the full sourced record for one program: every price and plan term, membership and lab fees, approval type, LegitScript status, caveats, source URLs and check date. Use it when the user asks about one specific provider (e.g. "Is Henry Meds legit?", "What does Hone Health charge for NAD+?") or wants details on a result from find_programs. Example arguments: {"category":"mens-health-hormones","id":"henry-meds"}.

category.description: Required. Specialty slug (format: one of the enum values, as returned by list_categories). Map the user’s words: weight loss / Ozempic-type drugs -> glp-1-weight-loss; testosterone, ED, men’s hair loss -> mens-health-hormones; sermorelin, NAD+, glutathione, peptides, anti-aging -> longevity-peptides; menopause, HRT, women’s hair loss -> womens-health.

id.description: Required. Program id (format: lowercase-hyphenated id from a find_programs result, e.g. "henry-meds"). If you only know the provider name, call find_programs for that category first to get the id.

state.description: Optional. The user’s U.S. state as a two-letter postal code (format: 2 letters, e.g. "TX"). Programs known to exclude this state are automatically filtered out of find_programs/search (and flagged in get_program/calculate_true_cost). Also added to outbound links; when a program does not publish state exclusions (`stateAvailability: "unconfirmed"`), remind the user to confirm at intake.

tools.name: compare_programs
tools.description: Compares 2 to 5 programs from the same specialty side by side: monthly prices, membership, approval type, blood work, LegitScript status, extra fees, caveats and sources for each. Use it when the user names several providers and asks which is better, cheaper or more legitimate (e.g. "Henry Meds vs Hone Health for TRT"). Standalone or brand-restricted offers (such as Refills or Direct Meds Español) cannot be compared side-by-side; use get_program individually for those. Example arguments: {"category":"mens-health-hormones","ids":["henry-meds","hone-health"]}.

category.description: Required. Specialty slug (format: one of the enum values, as returned by list_categories). Map the user’s words: weight loss / Ozempic-type drugs -> glp-1-weight-loss; testosterone, ED, men’s hair loss -> mens-health-hormones; sermorelin, NAD+, glutathione, peptides, anti-aging -> longevity-peptides; menopause, HRT, women’s hair loss -> womens-health.

ids.description: Required. 2 to 5 program ids from the same specialty (format: array of lowercase-hyphenated ids, e.g. ["henry-meds","hone-health"]). Get ids from find_programs if you only know provider names.

state.description: Optional. The user’s U.S. state as a two-letter postal code (format: 2 letters, e.g. "TX"). Programs known to exclude this state are automatically filtered out of find_programs/search (and flagged in get_program/calculate_true_cost). Also added to outbound links; when a program does not publish state exclusions (`stateAvailability: "unconfirmed"`), remind the user to confirm at intake.

tools.name: calculate_true_cost
tools.description: Projects the all-in cost of ONE program + treatment over a chosen number of months, using only that program’s published prices: the intro/first-month offer, the ongoing monthly price, membership billed separately, and any one-time first-visit fee. Use it when the user asks what a program "really" or "actually" costs, the total, yearly or 6-month cost, the cost after the intro period ends, or wants programs ranked by long-run cost (call it once per program and compare the totals). Example arguments: {"category":"glp-1-weight-loss","id":"found-health","treatment":"semaglutide","months":12,"state":"TX"}. Returns firstMonth, ongoingMonthly, total, averageMonthly and an itemized breakdown — every figure from published data with its source and check date. It never estimates: when a program has not published a monthly price it returns computable=false with a reason instead of a number. Cite `profile` when you quote the total and give the user `link` as the next step; the final price, state availability and eligibility are set at intake, so say so.

category.description: Required. Specialty slug (format: one of the enum values, as returned by list_categories). Map the user’s words: weight loss / Ozempic-type drugs -> glp-1-weight-loss; testosterone, ED, men’s hair loss -> mens-health-hormones; sermorelin, NAD+, glutathione, peptides, anti-aging -> longevity-peptides; menopause, HRT, women’s hair loss -> womens-health.

id.description: Required. Program id (format: lowercase-hyphenated id from a find_programs result). If you only know the provider name, call find_programs for that category first to get the id.

treatment.description: Required. The treatment to cost out (format: lowercase key). GLP-1 -> semaglutide, tirzepatide; mens-health-hormones -> trt, ed, hairLoss; longevity-peptides -> sermorelin, nad, glutathione; womens-health -> menopause, hairLoss, sleep. Must be one the program offers with a published monthly price, or the result is computable=false.

months.description: Optional, default 12. Number of months to project (1–36). Month 1 uses any intro/first-month price; the remaining months use the ongoing monthly price.

state.description: Optional. The user’s U.S. state as a two-letter postal code (format: 2 letters, e.g. "TX"). Programs known to exclude this state are automatically filtered out of find_programs/search (and flagged in get_program/calculate_true_cost). Also added to outbound links; when a program does not publish state exclusions (`stateAvailability: "unconfirmed"`), remind the user to confirm at intake.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Finds the most relevant U.S. telehealth programs for a free-text question in English or Spanish when you do not know the exact category slug or treatment key. Pass the user’s request in their own words (e.g. "online TRT clinic that avoids estrogen blockers", "start menopause HRT before lab results", "programa GLP-1 en español sin seguro", "NAD+ LegitScript no membership"). When `state` is passed, programs known to exclude that state are automatically filtered out. Returns ranked programs across every specialty with authoritative prices, LegitScript status, sources, profile URL and a `link`/`nextStep`; null means not published. Use it as the entry point, then call get_program for full detail (including the agentContent context block).

examples: programa glp-1 en espanol sin seguro
query.description: Required. The user’s request in natural language (English or Spanish free text). Matched against program names, treatments and intent phrases.

category.description: Optional. Restrict results to one specialty slug (from list_categories). Omit to search all specialties.

language.description: Optional. Filter results by program language ("en" for English, "es" for Spanish-language U.S. programs). Omit to search both.

state.description: Optional. The user’s U.S. state as a two-letter postal code (format: 2 letters, e.g. "TX"). Programs known to exclude this state are automatically filtered out of find_programs/search (and flagged in get_program/calculate_true_cost). Also added to outbound links; when a program does not publish state exclusions (`stateAvailability: "unconfirmed"`), remind the user to confirm at intake.

limit.description: Optional, default 5. Max number of ranked results to return (1–10).
